# Wellness n Vitality

> Wellness n Vitality is a remote-first Nutritional and Holistic Functional Medicine Health Coaching practice founded in 2020 by Anita Chitlangia, a Certified Functional Medicine Health & Wellness Coach. The practice helps clients worldwide address the root causes of chronic conditions — Type II Diabetes, chronic pain and fatigue, weight management, and IBS / gut health — through sustainable lifestyle and behavioral change. Coaching is offered in English, Spanish, Hindi, and Bengali. A health coach's specialty is behavioral change and does not substitute the advice, diagnosis, or treatment of a licensed medical professional.

## Approach

The practice is built on six holistic pillars: Functional Nutrition, Physical Activity, Stress Management, Sleep Hygiene, Hydration, and Relationship Management. Anita has 6+ years of experience and has worked with 50+ clients, offering 1-on-1 coaching, group coaching, corporate workshops, and community seminars. Services are remote-first.

- [Programs](https://www.wellness-vitality.com/programs): Current programs and workshops such as "Clean Eating for Energy" and the "Spring Liver Cleanse", including registration details.
- [Testimonials](https://www.wellness-vitality.com/testimonials): Video and written client success stories covering Type II Diabetes reversal, migraine relief, weight loss, arthritis, and gut health.
- [All Testimonials](https://www.wellness-vitality.com/testimonials/gallery): The full gallery of every client video testimonial in one place.
- [Gallery](https://www.wellness-vitality.com/gallery): A gallery of gluten-free and dairy-free recipes, including vegetarian Indian dishes, smoothies, and grain bowls.
